title: BAST/68/2023 of VIRENDRA KUMAR Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Short Term Bail Application No.68 of 2023
Virendra Kumar ........Applicant

Present:-
Mr. Naveen Bisht, Advocate holding brief of Mr. Lalit Sharma,
Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. S.C. Dumka, A.G.A. for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
 Applicant Virendra Kumar is in judicial custody
in FIR/Case Crime No.6 of 2023, dated 11.05.2023,
under Section 7 of The Prevention Of Corruption Act,
1988, Police Station Vigilance Sector, District Dehradun.
He has sought short term bail on the ground of illness.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and
perused the record.
3. It is argued that the applicant is suffering from
severe disease Glutin Silyak Spru, which is a stomach
disease, due to which, the applicant is restricted to
consume wheat products and, as such the applicant is to
more strict diet in absence of wheat and wheat products.

2
4. In fact, the applicant is facing trial in Special
Trial No.30 of 2023, State vs. Virendra Kumar, in the
court of Special Judge (Vigilance Garhwal Region)/7th
Additional Sessions Judge, Dehradun ("trial"). An
application with the similar relief was filed by the
applicant during trial, which was heard on 10.10.2023.
The order passed in the trial on 10.10.2023 is Annexure
No.3 to the short term bail application. It reveals that, in
fact, the court has exempted the applicant to appear
physically in the court and had permitted him to join the
proceedings through video conferencing. The court had
also directed the Superintendent, District Jail, Dehradun
to get treatment for the applicant and report at the
interval of 15 days before the court concerned.
5. The trial court has already taken note of the
disease, which is alleged that the applicant is suffering. In
fact, at the interval of 15 days, the trial court has sought
report from the Superintendent, District Jail, Dehradun.
There is no medical report, as such before this Court,
which may require further intervention in the matter.
Therefore, there is no reason to consider the short term
bail application. Accordingly, the short term bail
application deserves to be rejected.

3
6. The short term bail application is rejected.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 11.12.2023
Sanjay
